2160: His codename is Hei, which means black in Chinese. Hei is a very talented contractor, his Messier Code is BK-201. Hei lives two lives in the series. In public he is Li Shengshun, a foreign exchange student from China. He is very nice and well mannered.
2163: A member of Hei's team, an emotionless spirit medium known as a "Doll." Her power lies in tracking and observation through direct contact with water.
2165: His name means "cat" in Chinese. He is a Contractor who has lost his original body and now resides within that of a black cat. His messier code is HM-432.
2166: The Section-Chief of the Foreign Affairs Section 4 who is investigating matters that concern Contractors. Misaki has long brown hair and glasses and rarely smiles or laughs. She has a strong sense of justice and a sharp intuition.
3213: Kurasawa Gai is Japan's number one detective. Formerly known as Matsukichi Gai, he was a police officer who quit the force to start his own detective agency.
3214: Kiko is Kurasawa Gai's secretary/assistant. Usually referred to as "flat-chested" by Gai, she's an upbeat, energetic girl who loves anime and cosplaying. In fact, she prioritizes her two hobbies over her job responsibilities.
3571: The first confirmed Contractor, with her star's Messier code UB-001. She was originally a spy for MI6 with the codename February but later defected and joined the Syndicate, adopting "Amber" as her new name.
10314: A woman who supports November 11. Her power creates hurricanes which result in downpours, coating everything in water so that November 11 can freeze it. Her remuneration is to drink beer.
15548: Kirihara's friend since high school. She works under the the National Astronomical Observatory of Japan
15762: A young child most often seen being led around by April. He is a Doll whose observation powers rely on glass as a medium.
19289: A subordinate of Kirihara's. Traditionally wears a business suit. Despite being an officer, he seems to have little common sense as he infiltrated a gang operation undercover using his real name. He has admitted to finding Kirihara scary.
23761: The main female protagonist. A girl who lives in Vladivostok, Russia. In the Gemini of the Meteor story arc, Suou becomes involved in the war and machinations between the various groups and Contractors, and her life is forever changed when she meets Hei.
26597: An agent working in the FSB, Goran is a Contractor who is able to move at super speed in short distances. His remuneration is to eat hamburgers, and always has them handy for consumption whenever he is out on field work.
26649: Suou's twin brother. He loses his right eye due to an accident with a falling meteor core fragment, however this incident turns him into a Contractor. His power is telepathy and his remuneration is to use a wheelchair. (Wikipedia)
26650: August 7 is a Contractor and agent for MI6 who acts as a contact for April and July. He is also known as the Magician due to his love for magic tricks and his manner of dress: a long red cape and a top hat.
26708: An innocent and shy girl who is introduced in the beginning as Suou's friend. She mysteriously transforms into a contractor shortly after, changing her into a cold, emotionless person. Her power is radiation; her remuneration is pulling out her hair.
26903: Mina works with Genma and Youko for Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications. Her power is the ability to turn things into a weapon which she can use as a sword. Mina's remuneration is to kiss a man, which goes against her preference.
26904: Nikolay Lobanov is a boy one grade higher than, and in the same photography club, as Suou and the boyfriend of Tanya.
26905: A well known professor and is the father of Shion and Suou.
26906: Suou's classmate and friend, she is a usual Russian middle-schooler.
26907: He is a contractor who works for Ministry of Community and Affairs of Japan. His contractor power is the ability to manipulate materials around him into large protective armored suits. Materials such as steel and concrete are used.
27371: A known underworld information broker and specialist for having vast information and knowledge on a number of subjects, she recruits Hei to take down the Section 3 convoy before he cuts off all contact with her.
27759: An agent of Section 3. She was formerly a housewife to a local restaurant owner named Lebanon, who left him and their son Norio after turning to a Contractor by unknown means. She can manipulate a water source as a weapon.
28443: A sadist turned contractor that used to brutally murder women. Ironically, his power is the ability to manipulate his target's brain to release a chemical that results in their own euthanasia.
28738: A staff member of the MIAC team with Genma and Mina. She usually performs support duties such as driving them around or tapping radio communications.
31346: A Doll that travels with Madam Oreille throughout the anime. Has a twin sister named Bernice (also a Doll)
59067: Makimiya Asako is Suou and Shion's mother. She currently lives in Japan, where she works as a renowned landscape photographer.
